Instruction: Generate code that creates a project in Maxwell 2D using the PyAEDT library and runs a transient simulation. The code should import necessary libraries, set non-graphical mode, insert a Maxwell 2D design and save the project. It should create a rectangle and duplicate it, create an air region, assign windings to the sheets and a balloon to the air region, and plot the model. The code should also create a transient setup, create a rectangular plot, solve the model, create output and plot it using PyVista, generate the same plot outside AEDT, and finally close AEDT.

```python
from pyaedt import Maxwell2d
from pyaedt import generate_unique_folder_name
import os

# Set non-graphical mode
non_graphical = True

# Launch Maxwell 2D
project_name = generate_unique_folder_name("Maxwell2D_Transient")
app = Maxwell2d(projectname=project_name, specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=non_graphical)

# Insert a Maxwell 2D design
design_name = "TransientDesign"
app._insert_design(design_name, solution_type="Transient")

# Create a rectangle
rect1 = app.modeler.create_rectangle(position=[0, 0], dimension_list=[10, 5], name="Rect1", matname="copper")

# Duplicate the rectangle
rect2 = app.modeler.duplicate_along_line(rect1, vector=[12, 0, 0], nclones=1)[0]
app.modeler.rename_object(rect2, "Rect2")

# Create an air region
air_region = app.modeler.create_air_region(x_pos=20, y_pos=20, z_pos=0, x_neg=20, y_neg=20, z_neg=0, 
                                           model_type="2D", name="AirRegion")

# Assign windings to the rectangles (sheets)
winding1 = app.assign_winding(rect1, winding_type="Current", is_solid=False, current_value=1, name="Winding1")
winding2 = app.assign_winding("Rect2", winding_type="Current", is_solid=False, current_value=-1, name="Winding2")

# Assign a balloon boundary to the air region
app.assign_balloon(air_region)

# Plot the model
app.plot(show=True)

# Create a transient setup
setup = app.create_setup("TransientSetup")
setup.props["StopTime"] = "10ms"
setup.props["TimeStep"] = "0.1ms"
setup.update()

# Create a rectangular plot (field plot)
fieldplot = app.post.create_fieldplot_cutplane(objlist=[rect1, "Rect2"], quantity_name="B", 
                                               plot_type="Rectangular", intrinsics={"Time": "5ms"})

# Solve the model
app.analyze_all()

# Create output and plot it using PyVista
solution_data = app.post.get_solution_data(expressions="B", context=rect1, intrinsics={"Time": "5ms"})
solution_data.plot_pyvista()

# Generate the same plot outside AEDT using PyVista
import pyvista as pv
import numpy as np

# Extract data for plotting
x = solution_data.primary_sweep_values
y = solution_data.data_magnitude()
plotter = pv.Plotter()
plotter.add_mesh(pv.StructuredGrid(np.array(x), np.array(y)), scalars=y, cmap="viridis")
plotter.show()

# Save the project
app.save_project()

# Close AEDT
app.close_project()
app.release_desktop()
```
